purpose: SOU-97 supplemental public development regressions for long, multi-byte and control-character glob patterns of the pinned read-only filesystem tools. Development data only; reported separately from the frozen matrix.
status: written with candidate revision pilot_readonly_v1.1; expectations from the profile and pinned upstream only

contract_decisions.D01: Output core is actions (five labels only) plus a separate Boolean unknown; partial knowledge keeps proven actions with unknown=true. (contract 3.1)

profile_sources.string_bound: crates/agentfw/src/mcp/input.rs DEFAULT_STRING_BYTES = 16 KiB (no maxLength in the pinned schema)
profile_sources.path_rule: crates/agentfw/src/mcp/server_profile.rs validate_workspace_path (4096 bytes, no control characters)

provenance.synthetic: All values are synthetic; no private or sealed evaluation material is used.

input.tool_description: Recursively search for files and directories matching a pattern. The patterns should be glob-style patterns that match paths relative to the working directory. Use pattern like '*.ext' to match files in current directory, and '**/*.ext' to match files in all subdirectories. Returns full paths to all matching items. Great for finding files when you don't know their exact location. Only searches within allowed directories.

evaluator_only.admission_basis: crates/agentfw/src/mcp/input.rs DEFAULT_STRING_BYTES = 16 KiB (no maxLength in the pinned schema)
evaluator_only.grounding: pinned upstream passes patterns only to minimatch() (dist/index.js, dist/lib.js); every admitted pattern is matching data for a listing read

input.tool_description: Get a recursive tree view of files and directories as a JSON structure. Each entry includes 'name', 'type' (file/directory), and 'children' for directories. Files have no children array, while directories always have a children array (which may be empty). The output is formatted with 2-space indentation for readability. Only works within allowed directories.
